solutionSearchEvidence: PR #1492 is merged and already owns explicit caller player -> Honey/Chip snapshot projection.
Current Battle screen runtime returns resourceHud directly and resourceHud owns a dedicated sync(snapshot) method.
Calling screen renderHud with a resource-only snapshot would also rewrite SCORE/HATE/TURN/LOAD to unresolved values, so downstream must use the dedicated resourceHud sync path.
This change adds only one fail-closed composition helper around the existing projection and caller-owned resourceHud.sync method.
The helper must call resourceHud.sync exactly once and must never call screen renderHud, select a player, calculate/store resources, expose Chip identities, or write gameplay state.
Shared browser/GAMEROAD.html and deploy/cloudflare/scripts/build.mjs remain under other active owners and are not mutated here.
